name: A Spring Fling for Yanderes
source:
Riley (renamable & gender undefined), the playable character, has just transferred in to a new boarding school. 

Unbeknownst to them, the school is filled with a very unstable crowd.

Interact at your will with 7 different characters with their own paths. 

Learn the secrets behind the school.

Or die trying.

[From [url=https://faltazstudio.itch.io/a-spring-fling-for-yanderes]Itch.io[/url]]
